statuses.PROTOTYPE: Prototype: works in the demo, not yet validated
statuses.ANNOUNCED: Concept: a promise, with the test that will decide it

items.name: Drift detection
items.purpose: Adds up small deviations from a personal normal to flag a sustained upward drift.

items.name: Signed capsule
items.purpose: Detects any change made to a capsule after it was signed.

items.name: Offline sync
items.purpose: Two copies of the capsule, Earth and spacecraft, merge after a communication outage.

items.name: Heart rhythm variability
items.purpose: Computes beat-to-beat variability from a heart rhythm series.

items.name: Delay-tolerant messaging
items.purpose: Store-and-forward messages across a long Earth-spacecraft delay.
items.test: Send 1,000 simulated reports through a 6-hour outage and a 20-minute delay: every report arrives once, in order.

items.name: Pulse from a camera
items.purpose: Estimates pulse from video on the device. Fragile in real light.
items.test: Compare camera pulse with a chest strap on three people, including darker skin and low light.
items.drop_if: Error above 5 beats per minute on any of them.

items.name: Fatigue from eye blinks
items.purpose: Adds an eyelid-closure score, computed on the device and never recorded, as one more attention signal.
items.test: Ten seconds eyes open, ten seconds closed, on three people including darker skin and low light: the score separates the two.
items.drop_if: It fails on any of the three, or it needs video to leave the device.

items.name: Crew-wide or individual?
items.purpose: When several crew members drift together during a cabin CO2 episode, says 'shared signal, check the air' instead of pointing at one person.
items.test: Simulated crews on seeds never used for tuning, with a shared and an individual shift: at least 90 % correct attribution.

items.name: Exposure ledger
items.purpose: One gauge per crew member: 7-day cabin CO2 against NASA's 2.5 mmHg level and cumulative radiation dose, from real ISS data.
items.test: On every mission of the NASA file (RR-1 shown here; 14 missions in the replay): the cumulative dose shown equals the NASA data column, day by day.
items.drop_if: Any mismatch with the NASA file.

items.name: Offline explainer
items.purpose: A small language model on the device that retells each capsule in plain words, adding nothing medical.
items.test: 200 generated explanations: every number traces to a capsule field and every sentence passes the forbidden-word filter.
